# Sources — North America Data Center Dataset

Compiled September 2026. Grouped by what each source covers. Where a fact is genuinely disputed
between sources (e.g. xAI Colossus capacity, Dallas–Fort Worth total MW), more than one source is listed.

---

**How to use this with the CSV:** each row in `data_centers_north_america.csv` corresponds to one market
or named project. Cross-reference by company name (e.g. "Meta Hyperion") against the relevant section
above. Several rows draw on 2–3 sources at once where figures were cross-checked; the grouping above is
by topic rather than a strict one-source-per-row mapping.

**Caveat carried over from the map:** AI-megaproject capacity figures are genuinely contested even across
these sources — trackers differ because they count different things (leased colocation vs. hyperscaler-owned,
IT load vs. total power draw). Treat MW/GW figures as informed estimates as of September 2026, not audited numbers.
